# libffi 3.4.6

The x86 Windows sources from [libffi 3.4.6](https://github.com/libffi/libffi/releases/tag/v3.4.6),
used for the script evaluator's runtime-sized DLL calls. Sources are unchanged;
`ffi.h` and `fficonfig.h` are configured for static `i686-w64-mingw32` builds.
Other architecture backends and the upstream build system are omitted.

See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and the individual source notices.
